stemMd: Which inference is most strongly supported?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Shipping declined to zero after the office opened.

options.label: B
options.textMd: The harbour records counted only insured ships.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Some of the ledger increase reflected greater insurance participation rather than new voyages.

options.label: E
options.textMd: The old office insured smaller vessels more readily.

explanationMd: The modest arrival increase contrasts with the sharp insured-voyage increase. Cheaper policies and acceptance of small vessels explain why more existing activity could enter the insurance record.

distractorRationale.b: They counted arrivals regardless of insurance.
